core.title: Concealed Overhead Door Closer, Door Controls DC3023

text.description_html:
Light Spring Storefront Door Overhead Concealed Closer

DC USA Signature 30 Series Overhead Concealed Door Closer is constructed for all wood, metal, aluminum and hollow metal headers where aesthetically a surface mounted door closer will not work. The DC3023 is a Light Spring Tension door closer.

Features and Specifications:

  • Cast Iron Housing
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Spring Tension: #3 Light
  • Backstop: 90 degree
  • Non Handed (Double Acting - swings both ways)
  • Non-Hold Open
  • UL Listed

Sold Individually
